summary: Today’s tone is cautiously risk-off in crypto: Bitcoin and Ethereum are holding key support but most short-term commentary remains range-bound or defensive. Macro sources are also constructive on the dollar/real-rate backdrop and keep pressure on growth-sensitive assets, while crude oil positioning looks softer and gold remains a hedge-focused watchlist item.[2][4][1]
